body.message:
Unfortunately, due to the current situation, we are unable to offer refunds for bookings at this time.

Once the booking is confirmed, it will be considered non-refundable. To secure the reservation, the required deposit must be paid in advance. Additionally, the rental amount must be settled at least 7 days prior to the check-in date.

Please note that once the deposit has been paid, it will be considered non-refundable in the event of cancellation, and the booking will remain subject to our non-refundable cancellation policy.

We kindly ask you to take this policy into consideration before proceeding with the booking.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
